 9. Describe potential side eﬀ ects of two medications used to 
treat HIV infection that can alter nutritional status.
Th e zidovudine in combovir has been known to cause or 
exacerbate lipodystrophy. Th e protease inhibitor combina-
tion of lopinavir/ritonavir has been known to cause insulin 
resistance as well as body fat redistribution.
